label.purpose: Technical labels, versions, and measured values.

motion.name: entrance
motion.purpose: Fade and rise staggered README artwork groups.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Show all content immediately and remove decorative motion.

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Compact environment and feature metadata in README artwork.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 14px; min-height: 28px; border: 1px solid #293441; border-radius: 999px; background: #121821; color: #B9C7D7; font: 600 10px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-pill i { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: #2E9BFF; }

components.name: README Card
components.description: Outlined graphite panel for product previews and feature groupings.
components.html:
Independent sliders

Adjust one display without changing another.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 20px 24px; border: 1px solid #29313D; border-radius: 16px; background: #10141B; color: #F4F7FC; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 650 17px/1.3 'Golos Text', sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #A9B7C7; font: 500 12px/1.55 Inter, sans-serif; }

components.name: Primary README Action
components.description: Blue-gradient SVG action for the primary install path.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 32px; border: 1px solid #5DB9FF; border-radius: 15px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #79C8FF, #2188F6); color: #061321; font: 650 13px/1.3 'Golos Text', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 180ms ease, filter 180ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #79C8FF; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Lumen’s repository graphics follow the user-selected Tobi visual direction: deep near-black surfaces, precise blue light, fine outlines, and clear technical typography. The README is an editorial product surface with a confident statement, product preview, compact actions, and visual explanations of brightness control. Self-contained SVGs keep the typography consistent on GitHub without external font services.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black surfaces with restrained blue accents
Golos Text headlines, Inter copy, JetBrains Mono metadata

rules.name: One Accent
rules.body: Use the blue accent for controls, selected actions, and small highlights.

rules.name: Role-Based Type
rules.body: Keep mono for measurements and technical labels; use Inter for descriptions.

rules.name: Motion Has an Exit
rules.body: Animated assets must show all content immediately under reduced-motion preferences.

dos: Use quiet borders and tonal depth.
donts: Do not use heavy shadows or generic repeated card grids.
Do not set paragraphs in the mono face.
Do not rely on animation to reveal essential information.
